theorems.name: Submission.convex_open_exists_inner_exhaustion
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn n)), IsOpen U → Convex ℝ U → ∃ (O : ℕ → Set (Rn n)) (σ : ℕ → ℝ), Monotone O ∧ ⋃ j, O j = U ∧ Tendsto σ atTop (𝓝 0) ∧ ∀ j, IsOpen (O j) ∧ Convex ℝ (O j) ∧ 0 < σ j ∧ ∀ x ∈ O j, closedBall x (σ j) ⊆ U
